topic: SMS Review Request Script That Gets 70%+ Response for Local Contractors
title: SMS Review Script for Contractors (High Response)
title_options: Get More Reviews with One SMS
Simple Text to Boost Local Reviews
description:
Short, ready-to-use SMS scripts local contractors can send after a job. Low-cost, quick, and written for real customers who will actually reply.

One clean process, one example for plumbers, and exact wording to copy. No fluff — try it after your next job and track results yourself.

scenes.narration: One tip: send a short, immediate SMS with a direct review link and a simple ask.
Example for a plumber: "Hi Sam, thanks for today. If we did a good job, can you tap this quick review? [link]"
Send it within 30 minutes of finishing while the work is fresh and you’re still top of mind.
Use your business phone or a low-cost SMS provider to insert the direct Google or Facebook review link.
Keep it short, friendly, and clickable. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
